Last time I counted the 12 songs Paul played at every single one of my 13 shows. Today I counted the other end of that list.

85 different songs across 14 years. 12 he never dropped. 25 he played for me exactly once, and never again in any show I happened to be at.

One of them was Happy Birthday to You, live, in Buenos Aires, 2019. I have seen this man 13 times and heard him sing that particular song exactly once. FourFiveSeconds showed up only in Porto Alegre in 2017. Eight Days a Week, Lovely Rita, and One After 909 all landed on the same single night in Montevideo, 2014, a setlist that apparently decided to spend its luck all at once.

Twelve songs are a promise. Twenty five are a coin flip that only landed once. I did not get to choose which night got which song, and neither did anyone else in that crowd. You were either there for Happy Birthday to You in Buenos Aires or you were not, and there was no way to know in advance which show would be the one.

That is the part I like most about seeing an artist live over and over. The core repeats itself on purpose. The rest is just whatever the night decided to give you.

What is the one-time-only song from your own concert history?
